title: Find the kind of PM role that suits you
summary: The job changes a lot with the kind of product and the kind of organisation. Knowing the main variations helps you choose where to aim and what to learn first.

beginner: List the main kinds of PM role: general, growth, AI, data, technical, platform, transformation and hardware. Write one sentence on each. The add-on blocks in the Library show what each kind adds.

Compare kinds of organisation: a small start-up (wide scope, fast, few specialists), a scaling company (building its first processes), a large enterprise (specialist roles, governance and dependencies) and a public service (standards, accessibility and user needs).
Read how a PM describes the job at a start-up and how another describes it at a large company. Note the differences in scope, pace and process.
Match what you have found against your background and interests. Ask which kind of product you would still be curious about at five on a Friday.
Pick one or two kinds of role and one kind of organisation as a working hypothesis. Write why.
For your chosen kind, list what a PM there needs that a general PM does not, such as data and evaluation for AI products or internal customers for platforms. Keep the list for later.

toolExamples.notion: Keep a comparison table of roles and organisations with a column for what would be hardest for you.

definitionOfDone: One or two kinds of PM role chosen, with reasons
One kind of organisation chosen as a hypothesis
pitfalls: Choosing on hype, such as whatever is trending
Ruling out whole kinds of organisation without talking to anyone who works there
